February 14-22, 2026 | Natural Disasters Summary 

February 14
Inhambane | Mozambique - Tropical Cyclone Gezani made landfall, causing fatalities and massive power outages.
Arequipa | Peru - Torrential rain triggered severe urban flooding.
Antioquia | Colombia - Intense rainfall caused flash floods and landslides.

February 15
Guanare | Venezuela - River surge flooded the city during carnival celebrations.
Marmande | France - Historic river flooding cut off towns and left thousands without power.
North Island | New Zealand - Severe cyclone brought widespread flooding and evacuations.

February 16
Hawaii | USA - Kīlauea eruption produced lava fountains and ash plume up to 10 km.
Kyiv | Ukraine - Heavy snow, strong winds, and snowmelt caused transport chaos and flooding.
Coquimbo | Chile - Wildfire spread rapidly amid extreme heat.

February 17
Messina | Italy - Powerful coastal storm damaged embankments and infrastructure.
Valais | Switzerland - Major avalanche narrowly missed a passenger train.
Anadyr | Russia - Blizzard with hurricane-force winds paralyzed the city.

February 18
Taubaté | Brazil - Severe thunderstorm caused structural damage and outages.
Alausí | Ecuador - Mudslide damaged homes and blocked a highway.
Morowali | Indonesia - Industrial landslide killed one worker.

February 19
Kobuleti | Georgia - Strong Black Sea storm damaged coastal infrastructure.
Bloomington | USA - Destructive tornado damaged homes and businesses.
Crawford County | USA - Large tornado and hail caused severe damage.

February 20
Western Hungary | Hungary - Heavy snowfall and blizzards disrupted transport.
Sabah | Malaysia - Major flooding forced thousands to evacuate.
Lazio | Italy - Hailstorm and heavy rain caused localized flooding.

February 21
Trnava Region | Slovakia - Magnitude 4.3 earthquake felt near Bratislava.
Ayabaca | Peru - Heavy rains caused casualties and thousands affected.
Mendoza | Argentina - Severe storm with hail flooded neighborhoods.

February 22
Arequipa | Peru - Repeated flooding and mudflows inundated residential areas.
Padassari | Indonesia - Ongoing landslides displaced thousands.
Mindanao | Philippines - Torrential rains caused urban flooding and disruptions.

#ExtremeWeather #NaturalDisaster #Flooding #Storm #Tornado #Wildfire #Earthquake #Landslide #ClimateEvents #GlobalWeather
